fact: 1919年1月18日，巴黎和会在法国外交部（凯道赛）钟厅开幕，27个国家派出代表参加；和会由美、英、法、意、日五强主导，四巨头在145次非正式会谈中作出主要决定，再交全体会议批准。

sources.title: 法国外交部外交档案：The Peace Conference (Paris, 18 January 1919)
sources.quote: On 18 January 1919, the Peace Conference opened in Paris, bringing together the victors of the First World War to prepare the peace treaties.

sources.quote: Negotiations between the Allied powers started on 18 January in the Salle de l'Horloge at the French Foreign Ministry on the Quai d'Orsay in Paris. Initially, 70 delegates from 27 nations participated in the negotiations.

fact: 1919年6月28日，《凡尔赛条约》在凡尔赛宫镜厅签署，日期为奥匈皇储斐迪南遇刺五周年当天；条约共15章440条，1920年1月10日生效。

sources.title: House of Lords Library, Treaty of Versailles: 100th Anniversary (2019)
sources.quote: On 28 June 1919, the Treaty of Versailles was signed in the Hall of Mirrors in the Palace of Versailles. ... The treaty contained 440 clauses.

sources.title: The Peace Museum, Special Blog on Treaty of Versailles
sources.quote: On the 28th June 1919, exactly five years after the assassination of Arch Duke Franz Ferdinand, the Treaty of Versailles was signed in the Hall of Mirrors at the Palace of Versailles near Paris.

fact: 德国被排除在和会谈判之外：1919年5月7日德方代表团在凡尔赛收到条约草案，口头谈判被拒绝，反对意见只能书面提交；6月23日德国国民议会在协约国最后通牒压力下以237票对138票、5票弃权接受签约。

fact: 1919年巴黎仍实行食品配给：每户每日面包限300克，肉类每周供应四天；面包配给直到1919年6月才结束，食品供应随后逐步恢复正常。

fact: 到1919年，巴黎生活费用较战前上涨约300%至400%，不同来源给出的涨幅不一致。

sources.quote: By 1919, when L'Alimentation en temps de guerre appeared, the cost of living in Paris had increased by as much as 300 to 400 percent, depending on the source (Stovall 2012, pp.49-50).

fact: 依据1917年4月2日法令，在法居留超过两周的15岁以上外国人必须持有身份卡，每次变更住所均须由市长或警察局长签证；办卡通常收费100法郎，受聘入境劳工、学者、作家、学生或已入境劳工的亲属为40法郎；申请被拒者须在一周内离境。

sources.title: National Bureau of Economic Research, International Migrations, Vol. II, Ch. VIII: Migratory Movements between France and Foreign Lands
sources.quote: The decree of April 2, 1917, instituted a special identification card to be used by any foreigner over 15 years of age staying in France more than two weeks. This card had to be visaed by the mayor or commissioner of police in each place where the foreigner arrived or departed. ... he must show an employment certificate visaed by the Ministry of Labor or of Agriculture and pay ordinarily 100 francs, but only 40 francs if he is a foreigner regularly brought in, or a savant, writer, or student, or a relative of a wage earner already admitted. If the identification card is refused, the alien must leave within a week.

fact: 1919年法国贸易逆差约240亿法郎，国家支出542亿法郎，预算收入仅116亿法郎；一年内浮息债务增加276.53亿法郎，财政部向法兰西银行借款83.7亿法郎。1919年1月3日英国财政部通知不再向法国财政部垫款，同年12月美国财政部亦停止垫款。

sources.quote: This fall was due to the persistent deficit in the balance of trade (24,000 million fr. in 1919). ... The expenditure of the state ... amounted to 54,200 million fr. ...
